objective: Create a point-in-time OHLCV research dataset for independent 1M, 3M, 6M, and 9M investment-outcome discovery.
feature_principles: OHLCV and static instrument metadata only
No production rotation score or state inputs
No Path Risk or weekly recommendation inputs
Features may use date T and earlier only
Future outcomes are labels only and must never enter feature calculations
training_eligibility_rule: A row may enter a horizon-H training set only when outcome_end_date_H is <= the walk-forward model training cutoff date.
